Additionally, Lawson's return to Racing Bulls creates pricing algorithm uncertainty.

captains.label: Primary
captains.name: Kimi Antonelli
captains.reason: Consensus #1 captain across all channels. ML projects 24.0 exp pts (30.2 projected), ppm 2.07, LOW risk, DNF prob only 0.05. Monza 93-pt haul inflates projections slightly but his floor is high. FP1 hydraulics issue resolved by FP2 where he ran near the top. Every source agrees he is the clear 1A captain choice.

captains.label: Primary
captains.name: George Russell
captains.reason: P1 in both FP1 and FP2 — dominant Thursday. ML projects 21.4 exp pts, 37.1 projected (highest raw projected points of any driver), pred quali P1 → finish P1, MEDIUM risk. FanAmp ranks him best #2 option if Leclerc doesn't take penalty. Strong alternative captain if you don't own Antonelli.

captains.label: Differential
captains.name: Max Verstappen
captains.reason: FanAmp highlights Verstappen as the top differential — P2 in FP1, P3 in FP2, sneaking ahead of Ferraris in betting lines. ML projects 17.1 exp pts, ppm 0.76, MEDIUM risk, DNF 0.17. Channels favor him more than ML does (ML ranks him 5th on exp pts), but his upside at a track he's historically strong at makes him a viable differential captain pick at lower ownership.

captains.label: Differential
captains.name: Charles Leclerc
captains.reason: If engine penalty is taken, becomes a high-ceiling overtake machine from ~P20, potentially a 1B to Antonelli's 1A per FanAmp. ML is more cautious: 15.3 exp pts, ppm 0.64, MEDIUM risk, DNF 0.15, pred P5→P6 (no penalty scenario). Cheapest of the top-tier drivers at 24.0M, freeing budget for better B-tiers. Historical Baku specialist. Key uncertainty: penalty or no penalty changes his profile entirely.

buy.name: Alex Albon
buy.note: Strong Baku history (2, 12, 13 pts last 3 years). Williams bringing major chassis/weight-strip upgrade. Needs just 2 pts for price rise. ~50% ownership in global top 500. FanAmp and Pole Position both call him a must-have. ML may underrate him (BoxBox notes his sim position seems harsh).

buy.name: Franco Colapinto
buy.note: Averaging 11.1 pts/race, outperforming teammate Gasly recently. Back-to-back 14 and 13 pt scores. Only 1.6% owned in top 500 — massive differential. Longest active non-DNF streak. Needs only 2 pts for min price rise. Pole Position strongly recommends if you can't stretch to Lawson.

buy.name: Nico Hulkenberg
buy.note: Audi brought a massive 14-component upgrade package — biggest of the weekend. Excellent budget replacement for $3M assets like Perez/Stroll. Needs -3 pts for min price rise (very achievable). BoxBox and FanAmp both highlight him as a strong budget pick.

consider.name: Liam Lawson
consider.note: Returns to Racing Bulls at reduced price. Pricing algorithm uncertainty — may need 27+ pts for min price rise if treated as 'new' asset. Great driver but budget-building risk this week. ML projects Racing Bulls constructor at 25.6 exp pts (value 1.74). Consider for following weeks if price drops further.

consider.name: Gabriel Bortoleto
consider.note: Benefits from Audi's massive upgrade package. FanAmp says he 'could be a must-have' — but FP race pace data was underwhelming per BoxBox. Monitor FP3 closely before committing.

consider.name: Isack Hadjar
consider.note: Returns to Red Bull after wrist injury. ML projects 16.9 exp pts, value 1.17 (highest value score among top drivers), but pricing algorithm uncertainty similar to Lawson. MEDIUM risk, DNF 0.16. Worth monitoring but risky for budget-building.

consider.name: Ollie Bearman
consider.note: Engine failure in FP2 — must confirm car is repaired. BoxBox notes only 4 pts needed for min price rise and calls him 'very interesting' at 5.8M. Cheaper than Albon. Popular pre-weekend pick but reliability concern after FP2.

consider.name: Arvid Lindblad
consider.note: Wall contact in FP2 but car looked okay. Consistent finisher — keeps bringing car home. Needs 7 pts for min price rise. FanAmp comfortable with him if car is repaired.

consider.name: Pierre Gasly
consider.note: P7 in FP2 — FanAmp highlights him for teams that can't afford a 4A lineup. Alpine performing well. ML projects Alpine constructor at 21.4 exp pts with LOW risk.

arc: Baku kicks off a brutal stretch of three back-to-back triple headers with only one-week breaks between them (Azerbaijan→Malaysia/Bahrain→Singapore, then COTA→Mexico→Brazil, then Vegas→Qatar→Abu Dhabi). This makes budget-building critical now — the consensus move away from $3M assets toward 3A/3.5A lineups is designed to build a stronger roster for this marathon. Drivers like Albon and Colapinto who are near price rise thresholds could compound value across the triple header. Lawson's return to Racing Bulls at 9.7M creates a potential value play for Singapore (sprint weekend) if his price drops further. Chip management is paramount — save Limitless and 3x for sprint weekends in the upcoming stretch. The Audi upgrade package could make Hulkenberg/Bortoleto relevant budget picks for multiple races if it delivers. Williams' make-or-break upgrade determines whether Albon remains viable through year-end.
